# GitHub Copilot — repository instructions

**Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root and follow it.** It is
the canonical set of engineering rules for this repository. This file exists
only because VS Code applies `.github/copilot-instructions.md` unconditionally
while `AGENTS.md` is gated behind the `chat.useAgentsMdFile` setting. Do not
copy rules here — a rule that exists in two places drifts.
